rules.source_resampling: Only logical measurements use BOX reduction. Original art and nine tiles are never written or resampled.
rules.protection: Local dark density >0.16 over 7x7 at 2048; connected components >=20; close/fill/dilate and feather; native dark lines remain protected.
rules.regions: Nine existing terrainPlanning.areas polygons, 3.5% world Gaussian feather; artistic weights only. Original planning waters/ridges are not applied.
rules.clearings: Built 92x59 world-unit e-folding field, wild 45x34; feathered, asymmetric, low opacity, same nearby paper tone; water excluded.
rules.navigation: Input SHA recorded only. No navigation/layout/path writes and no playable climate/terrain definitions.
